content:
We can disagree and work together.

Watch: https://www.alethical.com/blog/events/forward-debate-2026

Trent Dilks https://trentformn13.com and Aaron Brutger @BrutgerforSD13 showed how. Some attendees called it the best debate they'd seen.

Next: plans for Minnesota debates and tools for candidates of any party.
